cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Every English sentence needs a subject. When there is no real one, English fills the seat with an empty it: It is raining. It is late. Czech needs nothing there: Prší. Je pozdě.
cards.body_cz: Anglická věta musí mít podmět. Když žádný skutečný není, sedadlo obsadí prázdné it. Česky tam nic není: Prší. Je pozdě.

cards.title: Why
cards.body: Without it the sentence is broken English: Is important to practise. ✗ → It is important to practise. ✓
cards.body_cz: Bez it je věta rozbitá — „Je důležité cvičit“ ≠ Is important…

cards.title: Form
cards.body: It + be + adjective + to + verb: It is easy to learn. Also: It seems that… · It takes an hour to… · It costs a lot to…
cards.body_cz: It + be + přídavné jméno + to + sloveso. Také It seems that… / It takes… / It costs…

cards.title: Where you need it
cards.body: Weather, time, distance: It is raining · It is five · It is far. Opinions: It is important/easy/nice to… People: It is kind OF you to help.
cards.body_cz: Počasí, čas, vzdálenost, hodnocení. U lidí: It is kind of you…

cards.title: CZ trap 1 — dropped subject
cards.body: „Zdá se, že…“ → Seems that… ✗ → It seems that… ✓ Czech starts with the verb; English cannot.
cards.body_cz: Čeština začíná slovesem, angličtina nesmí — vždy it dopředu.

cards.title: CZ trap 2 — there is not it
cards.body: There = something exists somewhere (There is a shop). Empty subject = it: There is important to… ✗ → It is important to… ✓
cards.body_cz: There is = něco někde je. Prázdný podmět = it, ne there.

cards.title: worth / no use + -ing
cards.body: It is worth trying. ✓ It is worth to try. ✗ After worth and no use: -ing form.
cards.body_cz: Stojí za to to zkusit = worth trying — ne „worth to try“.

cards.title: Practice focus
cards.body: Type the sentence OPENING: It + verb (+ adjective). (words) = your building blocks · (past) = past tense, no mark = present · (not) = negative. Quiz: pick the correct sentence.
cards.body_cz: Doplňte začátek věty: It + sloveso (+ přídavné jméno). Slova v závorce jsou stavební kameny; (past) = minulý čas; (not) = zápor.
